record.rationale: Low for prevention across different formulations. Cocoa-butter trials were inconclusive. One Centella-containing mixture had a positive trial, while another had a favorable subgroup despite no overall reduction. Massage plus almond oil was studied without secure randomization.
record.stage_safety: During pregnancy, check ingredients, especially retinoids. Stop irritating products. Prevention studies give little information about uncommon adverse effects.
record.limitations: Verify shea-only, vitamin E alone, genetic association and adverse-event reporting.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Very low for pregnancy prevention due to indirectness. A 23-trial adult synthesis found favorable pooled results, but benefits did not persist in the stratum without pharmaceutical-company funding. The subgroup is observational and may also reflect study quality or product differences.
record.stage_safety: Before conception, adult cosmetic findings apply only to similar populations. During pregnancy and lactation, product-specific safety and benefit for this indication remain unestablished.
record.limitations: Retrieve arm-level means, dispersions, funding definitions and pre-registered endpoints before plotting sponsor subgroups.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Low for comparative cosmetic benefit. Small active-comparator trials, variable phototypes, follow-up and physician rating scales limit estimates.
record.stage_safety: Defer elective procedures during pregnancy. Later assessment must account for healing, site, skin type and lactation. RF microneedling has a device-specific FDA harm warning.
record.limitations: Extract pigmentation harms by skin type and durability beyond one year. Separate contour surgery and loose skin.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Moderate for strength in that specific trial population. Lower certainty about an optimal program or durable improvement in pain. Within-group changes during early recovery can include natural healing.
record.stage_safety: The exercise trial does not establish immediate postpartum readiness. Wound problems, pain and pelvic heaviness warrant individual assessment.
record.limitations: Compare breathing, Pilates, loaded lifting and patient-reported function at the same timepoints.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Supported for some short-term pain outcomes, with limited blinding and inconsistent timepoints. Very low for permanent gap closure, excess skin or long-term cosmetic change.
record.stage_safety: After cesarean, clinician review of incision, fit and symptoms is appropriate. Rectus diastasis, hernia and wound separation require different evaluations.
record.limitations: Verify functional thresholds, binder adverse events, surgical indications and subsequent pregnancies.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Low for causal effects on appearance. Surgical literature is observational with varied definitions of feeding success. Sports bra studies concern movement and discomfort.
record.stage_safety: Support may be chosen across stages for comfort. A cosmetic procedure during recovery or lactation needs specialist assessment. Do not frame formula, breastfeeding or combined feeding as a cosmetic intervention.
record.limitations: Find prospective cohorts with pre-pregnancy measures, representative recruitment and objective shape outcomes.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Low for an exact exercise prescription that improves fecundability. Direct trial evidence is specific to an infertility population and an active comparator.
record.stage_safety: Before conception, avoid imposing trial weight-loss programs on general users. Once pregnant use pregnancy-specific exercise guidance.
record.limitations: Quantify resistance training specifically and identify partner-specific trials.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Moderate for a modest mean reduction in gain. Pooling different programs limits attribution to exercise alone. Data in high-risk groups require separate assessment.
record.stage_safety: Across trimesters adapt for comfort, balance and medical conditions. Stop and seek care for bleeding, painful contractions or fluid leakage. No calorie-deficit goal.
record.limitations: Extract sport-specific evidence, muscle retention, mobility and contraindications by diagnosis.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Supported for gradual activity after birth. Low or unassessed for specific readiness tests, exact lifting limits and universal return dates.
record.stage_safety: Immediate recovery after uncomplicated vaginal birth differs from major tearing, assisted birth, cesarean or medical complications. Progress individually in every pathway.
record.limitations: Obtain prospective injury data for return to running/lifting, including lactating athletes and cesarean subgroups.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Moderate for prevention of late pregnancy leakage and high for the 3–6 month postpartum outcome in the Cochrane review. Evidence is less certain for treatment, prolapse and later follow-up.
record.stage_safety: During pregnancy or recovery, supervision is useful for pain or difficulty contracting/relaxing. Discuss contraception before sex if pregnancy is undesired, including while breastfeeding.
record.limitations: Extract assisted-birth, biofeedback, dyspareunia and prolapse treatment trials by baseline symptoms.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Moderate for severe tears with warm compresses. Lower certainty for many other intrapartum techniques and continuous-support outcomes. Less suturing does not guarantee an intact perineum.
record.stage_safety: Antenatal measures belong in late pregnancy with maternity-team advice. Intrapartum techniques require consent. Compare planned vaginal, assisted and cesarean pathways with individual clinical indications and preferences.
record.limitations: Complete delayed pushing, epidural-stratified position trials, assisted birth harms and patient-valued outcomes.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: High for periconceptional folate and neural-tube defects. Iron studies can show better hematologic indices without resolving population-wide maternal/infant clinical benefit. A newer calcium review challenges older preeclampsia estimates after trustworthiness checks. Omega-3 review estimates and the later ORIP trial differ.
record.stage_safety: Review diet, existing supplements, deficiencies, interactions and overlapping products with the clinician. Avoid excessive preformed vitamin A. Choose lower-mercury fish using FDA species guidance. Review lactation needs separately.
record.limitations: Reconcile current calcium guideline jurisdiction and intake, iron screening vs treatment, trimester protein, vegan diets, multiples, adolescent and lactation targets.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Limited support for short-term nausea relief. Conflicting preeclampsia evidence and uncertain GDM prevention. Insufficient outcome and safety evidence for routine prenatal creatine.
record.stage_safety: Culinary intake differs from concentrated products. Do not infer rare fetal safety from short trials. Report product, timing and symptoms to clinician. Third-party testing addresses aspects of product quality, not clinical benefit.
record.limitations: Reconcile strains, metabolic risk, duplicate cohorts, adverse-event collection, purity and commercial involvement.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Guidance supports photoprotection and avoidance of retinoids during pregnancy. Limited observational precision for specific topical compounds, exposure intensity and rare outcomes.
record.stage_safety: Review retinoids before trying. Contact the prescriber promptly about any pregnancy exposure, distinguishing oral from topical. Check lactation and infant contact separately for each treatment.
record.limitations: Extract tinted vs untinted sunscreen trials by population and niacinamide-specific evidence, dose and lactation exposure.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Supported for the broad natural history. Precise incidence, predictors and supplement benefit are uncertain. Questionnaire studies have recall and selection bias.
record.stage_safety: Medication decisions differ in pregnancy and lactation. Minoxidil needs a product- and infant-specific assessment. Typical postpartum shedding does not establish deficiency.
record.limitations: Quantify longitudinal recovery by baseline diagnosis and verify treatment data for persistent shedding and nail changes.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Guideline-supported wound assessment. Low or very low certainty for many silicone outcomes; comparator, scar age and measurement scale matter. Pilot resuturing findings require larger trials.
record.stage_safety: Immediate postpartum: wound and infection assessment. Following closure: discuss silicone or scar therapy if symptomatic. Delay massage or elective devices until healing is assessed. Severe bleeding or systemic illness needs urgent care.
record.limitations: Extract wound-healing time, recurrence, comfort, silicone adherence, massage and post-closure sun protection.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Limited small-trial evidence for symptom relief. Insufficient evidence for cosmetic prevention. Clinical safety guidance takes priority when symptoms suggest thrombosis.
record.stage_safety: Pregnancy and postpartum: urgent symptoms override comfort advice. A stocking is not a diagnostic test or a substitute for prescribed thromboprophylaxis. Later vein procedures require vascular review.
record.limitations: Extract compression adherence, later treatment, postpartum risk factors and evidence for spider veins.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Low-to-moderate depending on pain outcome and comparator. A longitudinal cohort of 49 completers measured lower average arch height and greater foot length after pregnancy, with individual variation.
record.stage_safety: Antenatal treatment should be adapted to pregnancy by trained clinicians. Persistent postpartum pain or impaired mobility should prompt reassessment; provocative self-testing is unnecessary.
record.limitations: Extract acupuncture sham comparison, rib discomfort, ergonomics, falls, hypermobility and postpartum rehabilitation.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Guideline-based preconception care. Moderate certainty for the specific urinary-test population, with substantial manufacturer sponsorship. Fertility probabilities vary with age and duration of trying.
record.stage_safety: Do not stop needed medicines independently. Some vaccines belong before conception, others during pregnancy. Local schedules, products and seasonal timing need current clinical review.
record.limitations: Recheck US schedules near publication; research dental/genetic referrals, paternal exposures, multiple pregnancy, thyroid-specific indications and outcomes.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Moderate support for preventive counseling in higher-risk populations. Peer support is promising for defined settings. Body-image and sleep evidence varies by intervention, timing and measure.
record.stage_safety: During pregnancy and the year after delivery, thoughts of harming oneself or the baby need immediate help. Severe confusion or loss of contact with reality requires emergency assessment. Postpartum follow-up is an ongoing process.
record.limitations: Extract sleep interventions, treatment versus prevention, body-image measures, barriers and non-birthing partner outcomes.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Supported for treating periodontal disease. Larger randomized trials do not establish meaningful obstetric protection. Their intervals leave room for smaller effects.
record.stage_safety: Preventive, diagnostic and necessary restorative treatment may be provided during pregnancy according to ADA guidance. Individual medications and medical complications need coordination.
record.limitations: Complete subgroup extraction for severe disease, baseline risk, treatment response and dental access.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending

record.rationale: Moderate certainty for some breech presentation outcomes, uncertain harms. Pregnancy-specific efficacy and safety for the listed elective cosmetic indications remain insufficient in this set. Case series of medically necessary laser care have limited applicability.
record.stage_safety: No home procedure instructions. FDA reports serious injuries with certain RF microneedling uses. Specialist review is needed after healing and during lactation; regulatory clearance depends on device and indication.
record.limitations: Extract device-specific energy, indication, adverse events and skin type in appropriate settings. Review PRP, peptides, light, ultrasound and late surgery separately.
record.review_status: research draft; independent clinical review pending
